newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea allows IBRD, EBRD to issue won bonds.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea allows IBRD, EBRD to issue won bonds.

text.p: South Korea's finance ministry said on Monday it would allow the International and European Banks for Reconstruction and Development to issue won-denimonated bonds worth less than a total 80 billion won each.
The ministry said the IBRD, or World Bank, and EBRD would be allowed to issue the bonds in South Korea and to sell them on local and international markets.
The scale of the bond issues would be set within 80 billion won each after approval from the Securities Exchange Commission on Tuesday.
The World Bank and the European Bank applied to the South Korean government for the bond issues in 1996.
